scripts.postinstall: (cd abods-api && npm install) && (cd frontend && npm install)
scripts.start: concurrently --kill-others "npm run db" "npm run start:api" "npm run start:app"
scripts.lint: (cd abods-api && npm run lint) && (cd frontend && npm run lint)
scripts.lint:check: (cd abods-api && npm run lint:check) && (cd frontend && npm run lint:check)
scripts.type-check: (cd abods-api && npm run type-check) && (cd frontend && npm run type-check)
scripts.test:ci: (cd abods-api && npm run test) && (cd frontend && npm run test:ci)
